acceptance_criteria: Given a user with a registered email, When they request a password reset, Then a reset email is sent within a reasonable time.
Given a reset link that has expired, When the user clicks it, Then they see an expired link message.
Given repeated reset requests from the same source, When the rate limit is hit, Then further requests are throttled.
Given an invalid email address, When the reset is requested, Then a clear invalid email validation error is shown instead of a 500.
